current_activity: in the destroyer force that sank high-speed transports Gregory and Little off Lunga Point
notes: Night action off Lunga Point, 4–5 September 1942, in which high-speed transports Gregory (APD-3) and Little (APD-4) were sunk. JACAR 8th Fleet September 經過 (C08030022600, PDF p. 14, 攻撃実施 table) records 有明、夕立、初雪、叢雲 engaging 1 CA and 1 DD at 2200 in the 4 September landing sequence (wartime claim that both were sunk). Cressman, 5 September 1942, names Yudachi, Murakumo and Hatsuyuki as the ships that sank Gregory and Little off Lunga Point, 09°20'S, 160°01'E. The claim is dated 5 September, Cressman's calendar date for the sinking (the action was the night of 4–5). Ariake is named only in JACAR and is not entered. Confidence 0.7: JACAR (jacar) and Cressman (us_navy_nhhc) agree on this unit, the night, and the place off Lunga Point.
